serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: I’m in the mood for a corndog.
Bot: Corndog? That’s an unusual choice. I don’t think you can buy something like that near our home.
You: It’s a typical carnival food. I haven't eaten it in ages and that’s why I want to take one.
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: Then I’m gonna take one too!
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.sad
Bot: I had prepared some recommendations regarding which stall we chose, but I wasn’t prepared for the possibility of corndogs…
#bot.Expression.clear
You: Corndog is not complicated, it’s just a sausage with batter. Any stall serving it will do.
Bot: If you say so.
You: This one looks good, let’s order.
